head: Clyper AI clip maker turns long videos into vertical Shorts and Reels
dek: Clyper is a new AI clip maker on the web: paste a YouTube, Twitch, Google Drive or Dropbox link, or upload a file, and it cuts the video into vertical 9:16 clips with word-by-word captions. Paid plans start at 19 dollars a month.
details: It scores each clip by how strong its opening is and lists the strongest first, keeps the person talking in frame, and exports in 1080p without a watermark. Captions work in more than 50 languages. Every clip opens in an editor where you can trim to the word or extend either end, and edits don't use up credits.
means: If you turn podcasts, streams or long videos into Shorts, TikToks or Reels, this does the cutting and captions for you, for a monthly fee.
todo: Compare its plans on Clyper's pricing page with the clip tool you use now before paying.
